description: The public facts of Trailhead Supply as its website shows them: company name, address, opening hours, email and phones; every branch with its address, phone, hours, map link and whether orders can be collected there; messenger contact links; accepted payment methods and whether prices include VAT; the store warranty; the return terms; links to the legal pages; and the frequently asked questions with their answers.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

name: get_store_info

answer_type.description: What this answer is, for rendering.

vat_included.description: Whether shown prices include VAT; null when the store states nothing.

social.description: Social profile URL by network (facebook, instagram, ...).

truncated.description: Present and true only when the answer outgrew the size budget and its last list items were left out; ask narrower to see them.

warranty.description: The store default warranty; a product may carry its own.
